versions.content: Report of a link state change towards the EthSM and config- ured users for an EthIfController that acts independent of a MACsec opera- tional state Status: DRAFT If EthIf detects a link state change either as sole link state or as accumulated link state and the following conditions are valid: • an affected EthIfController references no MkaPaeInstance , • this affected EthIfController references either an EthIfTransceiver or an EthIfSwitch or an EthIfSwitchPortGroup then EthIf shall store the link state for this EthIfController and report the link state change by calling the following APIs with the changed link state (either ETHTRCV_ LINK_STATE_ACTIVE or ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN ): • call EthSM_TrcvLinkStateChg with CtrlIdx set to the affected EthIfCon- troller and TransceiverLinkState set to changed link state • call <User>_TrcvLinkStateChg for all configured users with CtrlIdx set to the affected EthIfController and TransceiverLinkState set to changed link state
